SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 本当にすみませんでした！！

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It was something I ate this morning—I’m so, so sorry...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那个...我早上肚子不舒服，真的很抱歉...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那個...我早上肚子不舒服，真的很抱歉...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 朝、お腹を壊してて…本当に申し訳ありません…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tadi aku makan sesuatu yang aneh pagi ini—aku sungguh-sungguh minta maaf...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O café da manhã não me caiu bem, juro que foi sem querer...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: El desayuno me cayó mal, lo siento de verdad...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: این چیزی بود که امروز صبح خوردم - خیلی متاسفم...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: N-No, please… don’t cry like that…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、いや…そんなに泣かないでくださいよ…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah... mas não chora, por favor...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah... pero no llore, por favor...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ن-نه خواهش میکنم اینطوری گریه نکن…

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 유만 씨 고마워... 내가 본의 아니게 신세를 좀... 졌네...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman, thank you… I owe you one. Even if it wasn’t on purpose…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 吴宥万，谢谢你...没想到会给你添麻烦...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 吳宥萬，謝謝你...沒想到會給你添麻煩...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさん、ありがとう… 迷惑かけちゃって…本当に助かったよ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yuman, makasih… Aku berutang banget sama kamu. Walaupun nggak sengaja sih…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Obrigada, Yumán… acabei te metendo em apuros sem querer...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Gracias, Yumán… sin querer te metí en problemas...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یومان، ممنونم... من یکی به تو مدیونم. حتی اگر عمدی نبود…

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いえ…でも、それはそれとして
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim... mas, deixando isso de lado...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Sí... pero, dejando eso de lado...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: the smell was honestly on another level.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这味道实在有点不寻常啊
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這味道不是普通的嚴重耶
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: においが普通じゃないレベルなんで
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: baunya tuh… bener-bener di luar nalar.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: o cheiro era de outro mundo.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: el olor era de otro mundo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بو صادقانه در سطح دیگری بود.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 병원 가 보셔야 되는 거 아니에요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Shouldn’t you maybe… see a doctor or something?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 您是不是该去医院看看啊？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 您是不是該去一趟醫院看看
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 病院行った方がいいんじゃないですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu nggak mau… periksa ke dokter gitu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você não acha que devia ir pro hospital?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿No cree que debería ir al hospital?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نباید ... به دکتر یا چیزی دیگر مراجعه کنید؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 창피하게 왜 그런 소리를 해! 빨리 와!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why would you say something so embarrassing?! Let’s just go—hurry!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这种丢人的事，别再说了！快走啦！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這種丟人的事，別再說了！快走啦！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 恥ずかしいこと言わないで！ 早く来なさい！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ng—ngapain sih ngomong yang bikin malu gitu?! Udah, ayo pergi—cepat!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Como você se atreve...?! Vem aqui agora!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چرا انقدر خجالت آور میگی؟! فقط برویم - عجله کن!
